name: riftbound-rivals
description: Riftbound Rivals - a real-time 1v1 card battler with a server-authoritative simulation

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @riftbound/server && npm run build -w @riftbound/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @riftbound/server && npm run typecheck -w @riftbound/client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @riftbound/shared
